Pages: a ditto for 30% of repeated values, a struck-out and rewritten value in 4% of rows, one slant of hand a page, one extra patient with an untracked diagnosis per 7 tracked. Wilson intervals treat lines as independent; lines on one page are not, so the intervals are too narrow.
